explanation: I did not search Mathlib, because this theorem has no Mathlib content to match. It says that two of the library's own definitions agree: `UnramifiedWhittaker.unipotent` and `unipotentGL2` (from `LanglandsTunnell.CubicInduction`). Both build the unipotent matrix in GL₂ of the adic completion of ℚ at v. The proof only uses `Units.ext`, the library lemma `unipotentGL2_coe`, and `simp` to unfold `UnramifiedWhittaker.unipotent`, so all the content is in the library's definitions. I did not open those definitions; their description here comes from their names and the proof.
